doc_hints.hint_excerpt: Resolve planning contradiction: 1. **Lexicographic graph selection vs scored scheduler tuple.** Runtime addenda and graph schemas disagree on the actual canonical selection rule.
Resolve planning contradiction: 2. **Automation-first vs interactive defaults.** HTE-by-default, visible-first local runs, and mandatory review flows contradict the stated automation-first direction.
Resolve planning contradiction: 3. **Single Overseer vs package + seam overseers.** Existing runtime docs still largely model one Overseer while the emerging design needs dual governance layers.

Resolve planning contradiction: 4. **Tier identifiers vs node/package/seam identity.** Many UI, storage, and envelope contracts still key execution to tier concepts where package/node/seam IDs are now needed.

Resolve planning contradiction: 5. **Single worktree / single project context vs multi-project lane-based orchestration.** Too many surfaces and schemas still assume one active repo/worktree/thread context at a time.

Resolve planning contradiction: 6. **Requested/effective state vs requested/effective execution identity.** The model exists for persona/model/platform but not yet for account or runtime actor identity.

Execute research follow-up: 1. **Lock the package/seam/lane object model.** Define canonical IDs, lifecycles, and schema placement for work packages, seams, lanes, promotions, reviews, and resolution threads.
Execute research follow-up: 2. **Extend the execution identity contract.** Add requested/effective account, overseer role, worktree/lane, and fallback reason fields to the canonical runtime snapshot.
Execute research follow-up: 3. **Specify package-based worktree lane pools.** Include lane allocation, SCM visibility, contamination detection, safe-point restore behavior, and cleanup boundaries.
Execute research follow-up: 4. **Unify attention routing.** Define how Dashboard, Orchestrator, chat-thread, and inline cards consume the same blocked/HITL/runtime event families.

Execute research follow-up: 5. **Reconcile automation-first with local execution UX.** Decide how `regular`, `visual_mode`, manual confirmations, and optional HITL boundaries map into one coherent mode policy.
Execute research follow-up: 6. **Upgrade graph/evidence schemas.** Add work-package/seam/promotion/account/lane identity to the schema bundle and align acceptance/coverage/evidence linkage.
Execute research follow-up: 7. **Consolidate addenda into anchor sections.** Prioritize runtime core, graph schemas, Run Graph view, newtools/FileSafe/worktree docs, and policy/terminology docs.
